members.name: source
members.doc: What produced the value: a label drag, a typed entry, an arrow key, or a double click reset.

members.name: unit
members.doc: The unit in effect after the change.

types.name: ScrubInputProps
types.doc: A compact number field for inspectors and property panels. Drag the label sideways to scrub the value (the pointer is locked when the browser allows it, so a long drag never runs out of screen), or click in and type an exact value. Typed entries accept arithmetic such as `12*2` or `(100-24)/2`, and a unit from `units` such as `50%`. Shift scrubs and steps ten times coarser, Alt ten times finer. At `min` and `max` the field strains past the limit with rubber band resistance and springs back on release. Arrow keys step, Enter commits, Escape restores the last value, and a double click on the label restores `resetValue`.

members.name: label
members.doc: Text or a 16px icon. Icon labels need `aria-label` so the field keeps an accessible name.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Fires for every change, including each step of a scrub.

members.name: onValueCommit
members.doc: Fires once when a change settles: a scrub ends, Enter or blur commits typing, or a key step lands.

members.name: step
members.doc: One step for arrows and scrubbing. Defaults to 1.

members.name: fineStep
members.doc: Step with Alt held. Defaults to a tenth of `step`.

members.name: coarseStep
members.doc: Step with Shift held. Defaults to ten times `step`.

members.name: precision
members.doc: Decimal places kept. Defaults to the precision of `fineStep`.

members.name: pixelsPerStep
members.doc: Pointer travel in px for one step while scrubbing. Defaults to 2.

members.name: wrap
members.doc: Values wrap around from `max` to `min` instead of stopping, as rotation does. Needs both limits.

members.name: unit
members.doc: The unit shown after the number. With more than one entry in `units`, it becomes a button that cycles them.

members.name: units
members.doc: Units a typed value may carry, such as ["px", "%"]. Defaults to the current unit.

members.name: resetValue
members.doc: Double click the label to return here.

members.name: track
members.doc: Shows how far the value sits between `min` and `max` as a quiet fill. On by default when both limits are set.

members.name: pointerLock
members.doc: Locks the pointer while scrubbing when the browser allows it. On by default.
